snippet.title: Tattoo Removal Simulator - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo now! 🎮 👉 https://bit.ly/steam_TRS9
Wishlist Tattoo Removal Simulator on Steam to support us!

Welcome back to the weirdly satisfying world of Tattoo Removal Simulator—now bigger, better, and more inked than ever! 

In this new trailer, we’re showing off what’s changed since our last reveal:
🧍‍♂️ More characters with wildly different backstories
🌍 New environments and expanded tools
🔓 A playable Steam demo to try it all yourself!
